definitions.gloss: dual income; both spouses working; two-income household
definitions.explanation: A household where both husband and wife work and earn income. A common arrangement in modern Japan, increasingly discussed in the context of work-life balance and childcare.

examples.japanese: うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共稼|ともかせ}ぎだ。
{共稼|ともかせ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of dual-income couples is increasing.

examples.japanese: {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many families feel that mortgage payments are tough without both spouses working.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧, which is the more common form in modern Japanese. {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ is slightly older but still used. Both refer to the same concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧ (a dual-income couple)
- {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (a dual-income household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧: dual income; both working — more common synonym, nearly interchangeable
- {片稼|かたかせ}ぎ: single-income — only one spouse working (less common term)
